🆕 NEW RELEASE: The Vandals release new holiday single Santa Claus Part 2

The Vandals have put out a new holiday single called "I Don't Believe In Santa Claus (Part 2)". Coverage describes it as the band's first entirely new Christmas song in about 30 years, following their 1996 album Oi To The World! Their Christmas Formal shows are listed for 16, 18 and 19 December 2026.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Rock am Ring and Rock im Park 2027 reveal first lineup

Rock am Ring and Rock im Park run side by side from 4 to 6 June 2027 and share one lineup, played in a different order at each site. Friday features blink-182 with Falling In Reverse, Billy Talent and Beartooth, while Saturday is led by Turnstile and Faith No More with Bad Religion. Bring Me The Horizon top Sunday.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Dead Poet Society announce 27-date UK and EU tour for 2027

Boston alt-rock band Dead Poet Society have confirmed a 27-date UK and EU run across 20 countries, tied to their new single "Roach". Four shows are in Germany: Munich on 12 February 2027, Berlin on 23 February, Cologne on 24 February and Hamburg on 26 February.
